title: Pokemon TCG Aromatisse Perfect Order 036/088 Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Aromatisse 036/088 Reverse Holo card from the Pokémon TCG Perfect Order set is a Psychic type Pokémon card featuring the character Aromatisse. Illustrated by Mori Yuu, this standard-sized card is manufactured by The Pokémon Company in the United States. With a rarity level of Uncommon, this English-language card is a valuable addition to any Pokémon TCG collection, boasting unique Reverse Holo finish and belonging to the Basic stage in the game.
